title: The AGENTS.md template points each agent at bin/devbin howto forllms in a project that vendors devbin
objective: In a project that vendors devbin, the AGENTS.md that Intent renders tells every agent to run `bin/devbin howto forllms` to learn how to use devbin. The change is one line in `lib/templates/llm/_AGENTS.md`, rendered only where the project vendors devbin.
context:
devbin 0.1.36 adds `bin/devbin howto <topic>`, with topics written for LLMs, and a reserved topic `forllms` that tells an LLM how to use it (hv's design, agreed at 09:19Z on 2026-11-27 by devbin-vc's date -u; devbin's vc decision 342). devbin-vc relayed this follow-up at Intent's close-out of 2026-11-27.

Not Started. It waits until devbin 0.1.36 is released and swept into Intent's tree.
